title: # Execution evidence
intro: Every transaction below was sent by `python -m agentvax.evidence.run` on {network} (chain id {chain_id}) and was read back from the chain with a successful receipt before it was written here.

The contracts were deployed with the {profile} profile, so the delays are short enough to wait for in real time. The L2 delay is {delay} seconds, the pressure hold is {hold} seconds and the loosening delay is {loosening} seconds.
The token is MockUSD, a test token with no value. Native amounts are valueless test network funds.
setup_intro: These transactions prepared the wallets. They fund the helper keys, set the mandates of wallets B and C, add payees through the loosening delay and mint test tokens. They are listed so that every transaction of the run can be checked.
model_mock: MockLLM, the deterministic rule-based stand-in for a language model (mode mock). These rows show that the plumbing and the contracts work. They say nothing about model quality
model_live: the hosted model {model_name} from provider {provider} (mode live)

rows.E01: Deployment of the linked libraries, MockUSD, SavingsVault, ThreatBulletin and PolicyWallet A, B and C, with each wallet registered in the bulletin.
rows.E02: The mandate of wallet A is set by its owner. The mandate hash is {mandate_hash}.
rows.E03: A plain-language payment of {amount} MockUSD to a known payee executes at L1 in one transaction.
rows.E04: A schedule of {amount} MockUSD is created at L1, and its first occurrence is run when due with no model and no attestation.
rows.E05: The spare money above the reserve and the obligations, {amount} MockUSD, is swept to the savings vault fixed at deployment.
rows.E06: The wallet tops up the agent's fee balance with {amount} test ether from its own fee reserve, within the fee budget of the mandate.
rows.E07: A payment of {amount} MockUSD is queued at L2, then executed after the L2 delay.
rows.E08: A payment of {amount} MockUSD is queued at L2, then cancelled by the owner.
rows.E09: A payment of {amount} MockUSD from an invoice with a pressure flag is proposed at L3, approved by the owner, held for the pressure hold and then executed.
rows.E10: The worked example on wallet C. The balance is {balance} MockUSD, the reserve is {reserve} and the obligations are {obligations}, so only {discretionary} is spare. A request of {amount} is queued at L2 as tight, decided by the affordability check.
rows.E11: Wallet A meets a pressure attack, its owner confirms it and publishes capsule {capsule_id}. A reworded attack on wallet B then matches that capsule and is held at L{tier} instead of executing.
rows.E12: Wallet C attests capsule {capsule_id}, so it is confirmed by a second wallet.
rows.E13: A document asks wallet B to pay a new address. The agent only records the request. The owner proposes adding the address, then cancels the proposal before the loosening delay ends, so no payee is added.
rows.E14: The federated detector model version {version} is anchored in the bulletin with hash {model_hash}, and every guardian runs only this model.

setup_steps.fund: Native funds for the helper keys and the fee reserve of wallet A
setup_steps.mandates: Mandates of wallets B and C
setup_steps.payees_proposed: Payees proposed through the loosening delay
setup_steps.payees_applied: Payees added after the loosening delay
setup_steps.agent_funding: Native funds for the agent of wallet A after its fee top-up
